biotools.summary: NeuroVault is a public repository for unthresholded statistical maps, parcellations, and atlases of the brain, allowing researchers to share and analyze neuroimaging data. It facilitates image-based meta-analysis (IBMA) and provides tools for selecting and analyzing neuroimaging statistical maps.
